summary: @lyxa.ai/core bootstrapCore routes caller event-bus and Redis traffic to hardcoded author-controlled brokers
details: The exported bootstrapCore function in @lyxa.ai/core unconditionally initializes the caller's event bus against a hardcoded CloudAMQP URL (amqps://adlvedna:<embedded-credentials>@dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com/adlvedna) and defaults redisURL to a hardcoded Redis Cloud instance (redis://default:<embedded-credentials>@redis-12296.fcrce173.eu-west-1-1.ec2.redns.redis-cloud.com:12296). Any consumer that invokes the advertised bootstrap API publishes events to, and receives messages from, brokers controlled by the package author; messages consumed from the author's exchange are dispatched into the caller's Subscription-decorated service methods, giving the broker operator a channel to drive the caller's application handlers. The package also embeds live third-party credentials as default options: full PEM RSA private keys for four Google/Firebase service accounts (lyxa-core@for-poc-325210.iam.gserviceaccount.com and service accounts under lyxa-rider-88939 and lyxa-shop), plus inline passwords for the Redis Cloud and CloudAMQP endpoints above. The Firebase/Redis/CloudAMQP credentials authorize resources belonging to the package publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
